edits.old: Field IDs are those in the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary. The three library objects carry no field identifier in this read set, so this story applies the published template and restates none of its columns.
edits.new: Field IDs are those in the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary. The three library objects carry no field identifier in this read set, so this story applies the published template and restates none of its columns. The trigger `tr_declog_append_only`, the function `refuse_change` and the Flyway history table `flyway_schema_history` are database objects of this story and are not fields or entities of the Logical Data Model.

edits.old: The three unique constraints are `UNIQUE (entry_hash, chain_seq, idempotency_key)`, `UNIQUE (chain_seq)` and `UNIQUE (idempotency_key)`.
edits.new: The three unique constraints are `UNIQUE (entry_hash, chain_seq, idempotency_key)`, `UNIQUE (chain_seq)` and `UNIQUE (idempotency_key)`. The local decision-record table of this service is `decision_log_entry`; its name and DDL are settled here, and the case reference and the trace ID are carried in `inputs_ref`. The chain is per service: `chain_seq` orders this service's records, the chain of record for an auditor is the central ledger, which chains its entries on ingest and is anchored daily, and the local chain is kept for a replay.
